sources.facts: Official ES product page lists OHLCV-1s, trades and TBBO in GLBX.MDP3; product availability spans the requested 2021–26 range. Schema-specific availability and daily conditions still require metadata checks.

sources.short_quote: If no trade occurs within the interval, no record is printed.
sources.facts: OHLCV schemas aggregate executed trades. One-second bars retain open, high, low, close and total volume; they do not preserve trade ordering inside a second or bid/ask and size. Bar ts_event is the inclusive interval start, based on ts_recv of source trades. A bar becomes fully known after its interval; its opening timestamp must not make its closing price available early. Missing bars cannot be automatically treated as missing feed or filled with synthetic trades.

sources.short_quote: This cost respects any discounts provided by flat rate plans.
sources.facts: Historical.metadata.get_cost returns the account-adjusted USD estimate for a specific historical request. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive. Ten-minute-aligned bounds avoid known overstatement; definitions/status use UTC-midnight bounds. Symbols must be explicit: None or ALL_SYMBOLS selects the whole dataset. Price quotation does not request time series; actual billing, if a later retrieval were authorized, follows bytes sent.

sources.short_quote: Access to metadata, symbology, and account management is free.
sources.facts: API requests authenticate with a Databento API key. The client defaults to DATABENTO_API_KEY, or accepts a constructor key. Authenticated account pricing is required to establish whether the existing user entitlement produces exactly 0 USD. No credentials were read or reused from another provider.
metadata.list_schemas(dataset="GLBX.MDP3") lists available formats; the official example includes ohlcv-1s, ohlcv-1m, trades and tbbo.

metadata.get_dataset_range(dataset="GLBX.MDP3") returns availability given the user entitlements, including per-schema start/end under schema. A product history start alone is not a per-schema/account availability proof.

ES.v.0 with stype_in="continuous" selects the volume-based front contract. It is suitable for a broad metadata quotation, not proof that its roll equals the already frozen native strategy roll. Final data should preserve exact raw contract, dated instrument mapping and frozen roll schedule.

local_inventory.important_limit: Raw metadata coverage, not a universal scan of all disks; SQX trade-result CSVs were not mistaken for vendor market trades. TBBO includes transactions plus top-of-book; its oldest checked file begins November 2025.

quote_only_api.zero_policy: Require an explicit numeric 0 USD estimate for each exact schema/symbol/start/end. Preserve request, timestamp and response. Do not treat API errors, missing cost, free signup credit or inferred entitlement as zero. Do not submit any time-series or batch request as part of this feasibility check.

acceptance_barrier.one_second_limit: Finer bars may reduce temporal aggregation mismatch, but they cannot prove within-second ordering or unchanged native fills. Keep the same acceptance thresholds and compare exact native candidate identity/decision/exit/net-R before training. No synthetic bid/ask, top-size imbalance or quote age can be inferred from OHLCV.
acceptance_barrier.feature_scope: The five-feature price-only five-year protocol must be validated under one-second input. The separate eight-feature HY104+SI experiment uses quote spread, imbalance and age that OHLCV does not contain; these may not be silently copied or invented.
